flores_passage_en: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training. A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company. A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience. A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training. Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
question_en: If a person had not attended a hostile environment course, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: They would have been better prepared for weapons training than someone who attended the course.
mc_answer2_en: They would have received more detailed information than a course provides.
mc_answer3_en: They would have lacked practical experience in first aid and role play related to war zones.

flores_passage_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others. It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information. In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998) The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times. Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.
question_en: Based on the passage, if asynchronous communication were not available to students, which of the following consequences would most likely occur?
mc_answer1_en: Students would be unable to access information at any time of day.
mc_answer2_en: Students would lose the ability to control the pace of instructional information.
mc_answer3_en: Students would be forced to wait until the next face-to-face meeting to submit questions to instructors.

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: If the person breaking the car window had not lost their car keys and it was actually their own car, how would the passage suggest observers would interpret the action?
mc_answer1_en: They would assume the person was practicing self-defense against an intruder.
mc_answer2_en: They would assume the person was trying to retrieve keys from inside the car.
mc_answer3_en: They would assume the person was attempting to break the window for no reason.

question: මෝටර් රථයේ වීදුරුව කඩන පුද්ගලයාට ඔහුගේ මෝටර් රථයේ යතුරු නැති වී නොතිබුණේ නම් සහ එය ඇත්ත වශයෙන්ම ඔහුගේම මෝටර් රථය වූයේ නම්, නිරීක්ෂකයන් එම ක්‍රියාව කෙසේ අර්ථ නිරූපණය කරනු ඇතැයි ඡේදය අනුව හැඟවේද?
mc_answer1: එම පුද්ගලයා අනවසරයෙන් ඇතුළු වූවෙකුට එරෙහිව ආත්මාරක්ෂාව පුහුණු වන බව ඔවුන් උපකල්පනය කරනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: එම පුද්ගලයා මෝටර් රථය තුළ ඇති යතුරු ලබා ගැනීමට උත්සාහ කරන බව ඔවුන් උපකල්පනය කරනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: එම පුද්ගලයා කිසිදු හේතුවක් නොමැතිව වීදුරුව කැඩීමට උත්සාහ කරන බව ඔවුන් උපකල්පනය කරනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: එම පුද්ගලයා නාඳුනන අයෙකුගේ මෝටර් රථයක් සොරකම් කිරීමට උත්සාහ කරන බව ඔවුන් උපකල්පනය කරනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain. Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak. But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel. However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
question_en: If the British Army had not lost most of its heavy weapons and supplies at Dunkirk, what would most likely have been the outcome of the planned German invasion of Britain?
mc_answer1_en: The Germans would have been forced to abandon the invasion plan entirely.
mc_answer2_en: The Royal Navy would have had no reason to avoid the invasion routes.
mc_answer3_en: The invasion would have been easily repelled due to stronger British ground defenses.
mc_answer4_en: The outcome of the invasion would have been more uncertain, but the Royal Navy's role would have remained decisive.
flores_passage: ප්‍රංශය වෙනුවෙන් වූ සටන අවසන් වීමත් සමඟ, ජර්මනිය බ්‍රිතාන්‍ය දූපත ආක්‍රමණය කිරීමට සූදානම් වීමට පටන් ගත්තේය. ජර්මනිය මෙම ප්‍රහාරයට "සීලයන් මෙහෙයුම" ("Operation Sealion") යන කේත නාමය ලබා දුන්නේය. බ්‍රිතාන්‍ය හමුදාව ඩන්කර්ක් වෙතින් ඉවත් කර ගැනීමේදී ඔවුන්ගේ බර අවි සහ සැපයුම්වලින් වැඩි ප්‍රමාණයක් අහිමි වී තිබූ බැවින්, හමුදාව තරමක් දුර්වල තත්ත්වයක පැවතුණි. නමුත් රාජකීය නාවික හමුදාව තවමත් ජර්මානු නාවික හමුදාවට ("Kriegsmarine") වඩා බෙහෙවින් ශක්තිමත්ව පැවති අතර, ඉංග්‍රීසි ඕඩය හරහා එවන ඕනෑම ආක්‍රමණික නෞකා බලඇණියක් විනාශ කිරීමට ඔවුන්ට හැකියාව තිබුණි. කෙසේ වෙතත්, ජර්මානු ගුවන් ප්‍රහාර මඟින් ඒවා ගිල්වා දමනු ඇතැයි අද්මිරාල්වරුන් බිය වූ බැවින්, ආක්‍රමණය සිදුවිය හැකි මාර්ග ආසන්නයේ ස්ථානගත කර තිබුණේ ඉතා සුළු රාජකීය නාවික හමුදා නැව් ප්‍රමාණයකි.
question: බ්‍රිතාන්‍ය හමුදාවට ඩන්කර්ක්හිදී තම බර අවි සහ සැපයුම්වලින් වැඩි ප්‍රමාණයක් අහිමි නොවූයේ නම්, බ්‍රිතාන්‍යය ආක්‍රමණය කිරීමට සැලසුම් කළ ජර්මානු ආක්‍රමණයේ ප්‍රතිඵලය බොහෝ දුරට කුමක් විය හැකිව තිබුණිද?
mc_answer1: ජර්මානුවන්ට ආක්‍රමණ සැලැස්ම මුළුමනින්ම අත්හැර දැමීමට බල කෙරෙනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: රාජකීය නාවික හමුදාවට ආක්‍රමණික මාර්ග මඟහැරීමට කිසිදු හේතුවක් නොතිබෙනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: වඩාත් ශක්තිමත් බ්‍රිතාන්‍ය ගොඩබිම් ආරක්ෂක ව්‍යූහය හේතුවෙන් ආක්‍රමණය පහසුවෙන්ම මැඩපැවැත්වීමට ඉඩ තිබුණි.
mc_answer4: ආක්‍රමණයේ ප්‍රතිඵලය වඩාත් අවිනිශ්චිත වන්නට තිබුණද, රාජකීය නාවික හමුදාවේ භූමිකාව තවදුරටත් තීරණාත්මකව පවතිනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: "The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean. It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean. With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as ""Hawaii down under"". Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development. The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki."
question_en: If the Cook Islands had not developed any large tourist hotels, which of the following statements would most accurately reflect a likely consequence based on the passage's description of the islands' character?
mc_answer1_en: The islands would likely still retain a quiet, less developed atmosphere reminiscent of Hawaii before statehood.
mc_answer2_en: The islands would be unable to attract any visitors from New Zealand or Hawaii.

question: කුක් දූපත් වල විශාල සංචාරක හෝටල් කිසිවක් සංවර්ධනය කර නොතිබුණේ නම්, ඡේදයේ දූපත්වල ස්වභාවය පිළිබඳ විස්තරය මත පදනම්ව වඩාත් නිවැරදිව පිළිබිඹු වන ප්‍රතිඵලය වන්නේ පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රකාශයන්ගෙන් කුමක්ද?

mc_answer2: දූපත් වලට නවසීලන්තයෙන් හෝ හවායි වලින් කිසිදු අමුත්තෙකු ආකර්ෂණය කර ගැනීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them. Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe. The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy. Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
question_en: Based on the passage, if the Upanishads had not been compiled, which of the following would most likely have been the case regarding the development of Sanskrit?

mc_answer2_en: Sanskrit would have become the primary language of modern Europe

However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain. It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.
question_en: If the arrest of Louis Jourdain had not occurred, what would most likely have been the immediate consequence for the Red Lake community based on the passage?

question: ඔබ සංචාරය කරන රට හදිසියේම සංචාරක උපදේශනයකට යටත් වුවහොත්, ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිවිපාකවලින් කුමක් සිදුවීමට බොහෝ දුරට ඉඩ තිබේද?

flores_passage_en: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women. question_en: If the mob of market women had not forced King Louis XVI and his family to leave Versailles on October 6th, 1789, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred based on the passage's description of the mob's actions and threats?
mc_answer1_en: The mob would have negotiated a peaceful agreement with the King regarding their return.
mc_answer2_en: The King and Queen would have been able to escape to another country before the mob arrived.
mc_answer3_en: The royal family would have remained safe at Versailles without facing public threats or humiliation.
mc_answer4_en: The royal guard would have successfully protected the family from the mob's aggression.

question: වෙළඳපොළ කාන්තාවන්ගේ පිරිස විසින් 1789 ඔක්තෝබර් 6 වන දින XVI වන ලුවී රජුට සහ ඔහුගේ පවුලේ අයට වර්සයිල්ස් හැර යාමට බල නොකළේ නම්, එම පිරිසේ ක්‍රියා සහ තර්ජන පිළිබඳ ඡේදයේ විස්තරය අනුව පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිඵලවලින් වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැකිව තිබුණේ කුමක්ද?

mc_answer2: එම පිරිස පැමිණීමට පෙර රජුට සහ රැජිනට වෙනත් රටකට පලා යාමට හැකි වනු ඇත.

mc_answer4: එම පිරිසේ ප්‍රචණ්ඩත්වයෙන් පවුල ආරක්ෂා කර ගැනීමට රාජකීය ආරක්ෂකයන් සමත් වනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families. In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially. Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances. There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
question_en: If the surcharge for having more than 2 passengers in taxis had never been implemented in Charlotte, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred based on the passage's information?
mc_answer1_en: Visitors would have found it more difficult to enjoy the city with children around.
mc_answer2_en: Families would have used taxis more frequently despite the general trend of avoiding them.

flores_passage_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states. flores_passage_en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation. Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts. It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states. The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
question_en: If the Articles of Confederation had been easily amendable, what would most likely have been a direct consequence of this change, based on the passage's description of the government's structural weaknesses?
mc_answer1_en: The central government could have adapted its rules to address enforcement issues and interstate conflicts more effectively.
mc_answer2_en: State representatives would have attended congressional sessions more consistently due to increased influence.
mc_answer3_en: A national executive branch would have been automatically established to enforce laws.

question: කොන්ෆෙඩරේෂන් ව්‍යවස්ථාව පහසුවෙන් සංශෝධනය කළ හැකි වූයේ නම්, රජයේ ව්‍යුහාත්මක දුර්වලතා පිළිබඳ ඡේදයේ විස්තරය මත පදනම්ව, එම වෙනසේ වඩාත්ම ඉඩ ඇති සෘජු ප්‍රතිඵලය කුමක් විය හැකිද?

flores_passage_en: "According to Ansa, ""police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession. question_en: According to the passage, what might have been a likely consequence if Provenzano had not ended Riina's war against the state?
mc_answer1_en: The mafia would have immediately dissolved due to the loss of key leaders.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, ප්‍රොවෙන්සානෝ රාජ්‍යයට එරෙහි රීනාගේ යුද්ධය අවසන් නොකළේ නම් සිදුවිය හැකිව තිබූ ප්‍රතිඵලය කුමක්ද?

mc_answer3: ලො පික්කෝලෝට පැරණි පරම්පරාවේ ලොක්කන්ගේ ගෞරවය දිනා ගැනීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: 1992 දී ජොවානි ෆැල්කෝන් සහ පාවුලෝ බෝර්සෙලිනෝ ඉලක්ක නොවනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots. Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous. These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves. A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk. Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
question_en: What would have been the most likely outcome for Triceratops if cycads had not been a common plant in the Cretaceous period?
mc_answer1_en: They would have relied more on their beaks to strip leaves from other tough plants, but their diet would have remained unchanged.
mc_answer2_en: They would have needed to adapt their feeding strategies to consume different plants that were available at the time.

mc_answer4_en: They would have avoided eating cycads entirely due to the risk of poisoning from other plants.

question: ක්‍රිටේෂස් යුගයේදී සයිකැඩ් ශාක බහුලව නොතිබුණේ නම් ට්‍රයිසෙරැටොප්ස් සතුන්ට වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැකි ප්‍රතිඵලය කුමක් විය හැකිද?

flores_passage_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock. Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly. Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize. Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna. If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
question_en: According to the passage, if scaffolding were not used in a new learning experience, what would most likely be the outcome?
mc_answer1_en: The learning experience would become more interesting but less effective, as scaffolding makes learning difficult.
mc_answer2_en: Students might struggle with procedures that are too challenging to handle alone, as scaffolds provide necessary support.

flores_passage_en: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain. If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate. Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise. Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
question_en: If the posted speed limits on the stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont had been higher, similar to other sections of the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, what would most likely have been the consequence for drivers unfamiliar with country roads?
mc_answer1_en: The speed limits would have matched those in the Pennsylvania Wilds, making driving safer overall.
mc_answer2_en: Drivers would have faced reduced risk due to improved mobile phone service coverage in that area.
mc_answer3_en: The likelihood of accidents would have increased because of steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves combined with higher speeds.
mc_answer4_en: Mobile phone service would have become weaker compared to the Pennsylvania Wilds.

question: ලක්ඛා සිං චප්පන් භෝග් භජනය ඉදිරිපත් නොකළේ නම්, සිදුවීම් පෙළගැස්ම පිළිබඳ ඡේදයේ විස්තරය මත පදනම්ව පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිඵල අතරින් වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: භජන් ගැයීමට රාජු ඛන්ඩෙල්වාල් නායකත්වය දෙනු ඇත

mc_answer3: චප්පන් භෝග් භජනය වෙනත් ගායකයෙකු විසින් ඉදිරිපත් කරනු ඇත
mc_answer4: චප්පන් භෝග් තැටි 108 බාබා ශ්‍යාම් වෙත පූජා නොකරනු ඇත

flores_passage_en: "Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the ""little brother"" of Germany and Japan. It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war. Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa. For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else. Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain."
question_en: According to the passage, if Italy had not built four new ships right before the beginning of the war, what would have been the most likely consequence for their African campaign plans?
mc_answer1_en: Italy would have focused its attention on capturing European countries instead of African nations.
mc_answer2_en: Italy would have been unable to sail across the Mediterranean Sea to launch troops.
mc_answer3_en: Italy's navy would have been even weaker, making it harder to neutralize British bases in Egypt.
mc_answer4_en: Japan would have been forced to take over Italy's role in the Mediterranean region.
flores_passage: අපි ඉතාලියේ සැලසුම් පිළිබඳ පැහැදිලි කිරීමකින් ආරම්භ කරමු. ඉතාලිය ප්‍රධාන වශයෙන් ජර්මනියේ සහ ජපානයේ "කුඩා සහෝදරයා" විය. යුද්ධය ආරම්භ වීමට തൊට පෙර ඔවුන් නව නැව් හතරක් නිපදවා තිබුණද, ඔවුන්ට වඩා දුර්වල හමුදාවක් සහ දුර්වල නාවික හමුදාවක් තිබුණි. ඉතාලියේ ප්‍රධාන ඉලක්ක වූයේ අප්‍රිකානු රටවල්ය. එම රටවල් අල්ලා ගැනීමට, හමුදාවන්ට මධ්‍යධරණී මුහුද හරහා යාත්‍රා කර අප්‍රිකාව ආක්‍රමණය කිරීමට හැකි වන පරිදි භට පිරිස් පිටත් කර හැරීමේ වේදිකාවක් ඔවුන්ට අවශ්‍ය විය. ඒ සඳහා ඔවුන්ට ඊජිප්තුවේ පිහිටි බ්‍රිතාන්‍ය කඳවුරු සහ නැව් විනාශ කර දැමීමට සිදු විය. එම ක්‍රියාමාර්ග හැරුණු විට ඉතාලියේ යුද නැව් වෙනත් කිසිවක් කිරීමට නියමිතව නොතිබුණි. දැන් ජපානය ගැන බලමු. ජපානය ද බ්‍රිතාන්‍යය මෙන්ම දූපත් රටක් විය.
question: ඡේදයට අනුව, යුද්ධය ආරම්භ වීමට തൊට පෙර ඉතාලිය නව නැව් හතරක් ගොඩනඟා නොතිබුණේ නම්, ඔවුන්ගේ අප්‍රිකානු මෙහෙයුම් සැලසුම් සඳහා ඇති විය හැකි වැඩිම ඉඩක් සහිත ප්‍රතිවිපාකය කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: ඉතාලිය අප්‍රිකානු ජාතීන් වෙනුවට යුරෝපීය රටවල් අල්ලා ගැනීම කෙරෙහි සිය අවධානය යොමු කරනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: භට පිරිස් යැවීම සඳහා මධ්‍යධරණී මුහුද හරහා යාත්‍රා කිරීමට ඉතාලියට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: ඉතාලියේ නාවික හමුදාව තවත් දුර්වල වන අතර, එමඟින් ඊජිප්තුවේ බ්‍රිතාන්‍ය කඳවුරු නිෂ්ක්‍රීය කිරීම වඩාත් දුෂ්කර වනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: මධ්‍යධරණී කලාපය තුළ ඉතාලියේ කාර්යභාරය භාර ගැනීමට ජපානයට බල කෙරෙනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy. The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter. Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy. The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does. This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
question_en: If the Milky Way had not exerted a gravitational force on the Sagittarius galaxy, which of the following outcomes would most likely have been observed by the team?
mc_answer1_en: The simulated observations would have shown no tidal forces affecting the distribution of dark matter particles.
mc_answer2_en: The scientists would have concluded that dark matter particles only interact with regular matter.

question: ක්ෂීරපථය විසින් ධනු මන්දාකිණිය මත ගුරුත්වාකර්ෂණ බලයක් යොදවා නොතිබුණේ නම්, කණ්ඩායම විසින් නිරීක්ෂණය කිරීමට බොහෝ දුරට ඉඩ තිබුණේ පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිඵලවලින් කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: අනුකරණය කරන ලද නිරීක්ෂණ මගින් අඳුරු පදාර්ථ අංශු ව්‍යාප්තියට බලපාන කිසිදු උදම් බලයක් නොපෙන්වනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: අඳුරු පදාර්ථ අංශු අන්තර්ක්‍රියා කරන්නේ සාමාන්‍ය පදාර්ථය සමඟ පමණක් බව විද්‍යාඥයින් නිගමනය කරනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps. At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient. The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures. Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole. Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
question_en: If a pedestrian had not worn footwear with suitable soles during a winter storm, which of the following outcomes is most likely based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: The pedestrian would have walked more quickly to avoid the slippery conditions.
mc_answer2_en: The pedestrian would have been protected by the salt scattered on the roads.
mc_answer3_en: The pedestrian would have likely slipped on icy steps due to inadequate traction.
mc_answer4_en: The pedestrian would have experienced increased warmth due to the absence of studs.

flores_passage_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences. Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history. International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants. Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not. These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes a counterfactual consequence if International Horticultural Expositions were held annually in the same country instead of different countries?
mc_answer1_en: The requirement for sites to be no smaller than 50 hectares would likely be waived to accommodate repeated use.
mc_answer2_en: The duration of the exposition would automatically shorten to one month to reduce costs.
mc_answer3_en: Participating countries would be required to present only artistic displays rather than educational ones.
mc_answer4_en: The logistical strain on the host country's infrastructure and resources would likely increase significantly over time.
flores_passage: ලෝක ප්‍රදර්ශනයක් (සාමාන්‍යයෙන් World Exposition, හෝ සරලව Expo ලෙස හැඳින්වේ) යනු කලා හා විද්‍යාවන් පිළිබඳ මහා ජාත්‍යන්තර උළෙලකි. සහභාගී වන රටවල් ලෝක ගැටලු හෝ තම රටේ සංස්කෘතිය සහ ඉතිහාසය විදහා දැක්වීම සඳහා ජාතික මණ්ඩප තුළ කලාත්මක හා අධ්‍යාපනික ප්‍රදර්ශන ඉදිරිපත් කරයි. ජාත්‍යන්තර උද්‍යාන විද්‍යාත්මක ප්‍රදර්ශන යනු මල් ප්‍රදර්ශන, උද්භිද උද්‍යාන සහ ශාක හා සම්බන්ධ ඕනෑම දෙයක් ප්‍රදර්ශනය කෙරෙන විශේෂිත ඉසව් වේ. න්‍යායාත්මකව ඒවා (විවිධ රටවල පවත්වන්නේ නම්) වාර්ෂිකව පැවැත්විය හැකි වුවද, ප්‍රායෝගිකව එසේ සිදු නොවේ. මෙම ඉසව් සාමාන්‍යයෙන් මාස තුනත් හයත් අතර කාලයක් පවතින අතර, හෙක්ටයාර 50කට නොඅඩු භූමි ප්‍රදේශවල පවත්වනු ලැබේ.
question: මෙම ඡේදය මත පදනම්ව, විවිධ රටවල වෙනුවට එකම රටක ජාත්‍යන්තර උද්‍යාන විද්‍යාත්මක ප්‍රදර්ශන වාර්ෂිකව පවත්වනු ලැබුවහොත් ඇති විය හැකි ප්‍රතිවිරෝධී (counterfactual) ප්‍රතිවිපාකය වඩාත් හොඳින් විස්තර කරන්නේ පහත සඳහන් කුමක් මඟින්ද?
mc_answer1: නැවත නැවත භාවිතයට පහසුකම් සැලසීම සඳහා ස්ථාන හෙක්ටයාර 50කට නොඅඩු විය යුතුය යන අවශ්‍යතාවය බොහෝ දුරට ඉවත් කරනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: වියදම් අඩු කිරීම සඳහා ප්‍රදර්ශන කාලය ස්වයංක්‍රීයවම මාසයක් දක්වා කෙටි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: සහභාගී වන රටවලට අධ්‍යාපනික ප්‍රදර්ශන වෙනුවට කලාත්මක ප්‍රදර්ශන පමණක් ඉදිරිපත් කිරීමට සිදු වනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: සත්කාරක රටේ යටිතල පහසුකම් සහ සම්පත් මත ඇති වන සැපයුම්මය පීඩනය කාලයත් සමඟ සැලකිය යුතු ලෙස වැඩි වනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July. The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos. The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides. Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year. Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
question_en: If the Indian government had not delayed the vaccine delivery plans due to lack of funds and low prioritisation, what would most likely have been the consequence for the historically most affected areas this year?
mc_answer1_en: They would have received the vaccine doses earlier than planned, but the outbreak would have worsened due to increased mosquito activity.
mc_answer2_en: They would have received the vaccine doses earlier than planned, but the health agencies would have been unable to prepare for next year.
mc_answer3_en: They would have received the vaccine doses earlier than planned, but the government would have had to cancel the pig catcher deployment.
mc_answer4_en: They would have received the vaccine doses earlier than planned, improving immediate protection against the outbreak.

question: ඉන්දීය රජය අරමුදල් නොමැතිකම සහ අඩු ප්‍රමුඛතාවය නිසා එන්නත් ලබා දීමේ සැලසුම් ප්‍රමාද නොකළේ නම්, ඓතිහාසිකව වඩාත්ම බලපෑමට ලක් වූ ප්‍රදේශවලට මේ වසරේ බොහෝ දුරට ඇති විය හැකිව තිබූ ප්‍රතිඵලය කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: ඔවුන්ට සැලසුම් කළ කාලයට වඩා කලින් එන්නත් මාත්‍රාවන් ලැබෙනු ඇත, නමුත් මදුරු ක්‍රියාකාරිත්වය වැඩිවීම නිසා රෝගය පැතිරීම තවත් නරක අතට හැරෙනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: ඔවුන්ට සැලසුම් කළ කාලයට වඩා කලින් එන්නත් මාත්‍රාවන් ලැබෙනු ඇත, නමුත් සෞඛ්‍ය ආයතනවලට ලබන වසර සඳහා සූදානම් වීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: ඔවුන්ට සැලසුම් කළ කාලයට වඩා කලින් එන්නත් මාත්‍රාවන් ලැබෙනු ඇත, නමුත් රජයට ඌරන් අල්ලන්නන් යෙදවීම අවලංගු කිරීමට සිදුවනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus. The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour. To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite. The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore. This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
question_en: If the British colonizers had not chosen the northern shore of Hong Kong Island for their own use, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: Tourists would have focused on the Victoria Harbour waters rather than the skyline.
mc_answer2_en: The reclaimed land would not have been developed for urban use at all.

flores_passage_en: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation. he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations. Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world. In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation. Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
question_en: If Muhammad had not frequently visited the cave of Hira‘ for contemplation, which of the following outcomes would most likely have been true based on the passage's description of his spiritual inclinations?
mc_answer1_en: The sky above the cave would have appeared less clear and beautiful to him.
mc_answer2_en: He would have moved to a different mountain to find a more accessible place for worship.
mc_answer3_en: The cave itself would have been destroyed or forgotten due to lack of spiritual significance.
mc_answer4_en: He would have remained as deeply engaged with the mundane aspects of daily life without seeking spiritual isolation.

question: මුහම්මද් තුමා මෙනෙහි කිරීම සඳහා හිරා ගුහාවට නිතර නොගියේ නම්, ඔහුගේ ආධ්‍යාත්මික නැඹුරුව පිළිබඳ ඡේදයේ විස්තරය මත පදනම්ව පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිඵල අතරින් වඩාත්ම සත්‍ය විය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

mc_answer2: වන්දනාමාන කිරීම සඳහා වඩාත් පහසුවෙන් ළඟා විය හැකි ස්ථානයක් සොයා ගැනීමට ඔහු වෙනත් කන්දකට යන්නට තිබුණි.

flores_passage_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana. The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay. In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic. You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls. On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
question_en: If the rainy season had not occurred this year, what would most likely be the impact on a tourist's experience at Victoria Falls?
mc_answer1_en: Tourists would be unable to visit the town due to dangerous flooding conditions.
mc_answer2_en: Tourists would be more likely to get wet while crossing the bridge or walking along the trails.
mc_answer3_en: Tourists would find the adventure activities more appealing due to increased water volume.
mc_answer4_en: Tourists would have a clearer view of the actual Falls but might find the scenery less dramatic.

question: මේ වසරේ වැසි සමය නොපැමිණියේ නම්, වික්ටෝරියා දිය ඇල්ලේ සංචාරකයෙකුගේ අත්දැකීමට වැඩිපුරම ඇති විය හැකි බලපෑම කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: අනතුරුදායක ගංවතුර තත්ත්වයන් හේතුවෙන් සංචාරකයින්ට නගරයට පැමිණීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: පාලම තරණය කිරීමේදී හෝ මංපෙත් දිගේ ඇවිදීමේදී සංචාරකයින් තෙමීමට වැඩි ඉඩක් ඇත.
mc_answer3: ජල පරිමාව වැඩිවීම හේතුවෙන් සංචාරකයින්ට වික්‍රමාන්විත ක්‍රියාකාරකම් වඩාත් ආකර්ෂණීය ලෙස පෙනෙනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: සංචාරකයින්ට සැබෑ දිය ඇල්ල වඩාත් පැහැදිලිව දැකගත හැකි වුවද, දර්ශනය අඩු චමත්කාරජනක බවක් පෙනෙන්නට පුළුවන.

flores_passage_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king. Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration. Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible. The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo. Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
question_en: According to the passage, if Howard Carter had not discovered the tomb of Tutankhamun in 1922, which of the following would most likely be true?
mc_answer1_en: The treasures from the tomb would have been automatically transferred to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.
mc_answer2_en: The mummy's head and shoulders would have been more visible than in the actual historical record.
mc_answer3_en: The tomb would remain undiscovered and the royal burial would not be known to the public in the modern era.
mc_answer4_en: Visitors would have been advised to spend their time elsewhere even if the tomb were discovered.

question: මෙම ඡේදයට අනුව, 1922 දී හොවාර්ඩ් කාටර් විසින් ටුටන්කාමන්ගේ සොහොන සොයා නොගත්තේ නම්, පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රකාශ අතරින් වඩාත්ම සත්‍ය විය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

flores_passage_en: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment. According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest. Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s. The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti. Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
question_en: According to the passage, what would most likely have happened if the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion had not arrived in Haiti in 2010?
mc_answer1_en: The UN would have immediately relocated its peacekeeping camp to another country.
mc_answer2_en: Haitian authorities would have independently discovered the bacteria in the river before 2010.
mc_answer3_en: Haiti would have continued to have no outbreaks of the disease since the 1800s.

flores_passage_en: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today. It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos. The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East. The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction. question_en: Based on the passage, if the Iraq Study Group's recommendation for a new diplomatic initiative had not been implemented by the end of the year, which of the following consequences would most likely have occurred according to the report's logic?

mc_answer3_en: Iraq's borders might have remained vulnerable to hostile interventions from neighboring countries

flores_passage: ඉරාක අධ්‍යයන කණ්ඩායම අද GMT 12.00 ට සිය වාර්තාව ඉදිරිපත් කළේය. මේ අවස්ථාවේ ඉරාකය තුළ ගනු ලබන කිසිදු ක්‍රියාමාර්ගයකින් නිකායික යුද්ධය, වර්ධනය වන ප්‍රචණ්ඩත්වය හෝ අවුල් සහගත තත්ත්වයකට ඇද වැටීම නැවැත්විය හැකි බවට කිසිවෙකුට සහතික විය නොහැකි බවට එය අනතුරු අඟවයි. මෙම වාර්තාව ආරම්භ වන්නේ මැදපෙරදිග පිළිබඳ ප්‍රතිපත්තිය සම්බන්ධයෙන් විවෘත විවාදයක් පැවැත්වීමට සහ එක්සත් ජනපදය තුළ සම්මුතියක් ගොඩනැගීමට කරන ආයාචනයකිනි. ඉරාකය සම්බන්ධයෙන් විධායකයේ වත්මන් ප්‍රතිපත්තියේ සෑම අංශයක්ම පාහේ දැඩි ලෙස විවේචනය කරන මෙම වාර්තාව, ක්ෂණික දිශානති වෙනසක් ඉල්ලා සිටියි. එහි නිර්දේශ 78 න් පළමුවැන්න වන්නේ, සතුරු මැදිහත්වීම්වලින් ඉරාකයේ දේශසීමා ආරක්ෂා කර ගැනීමට සහ එහි අසල්වැසියන් සමඟ රාජ්‍ය තාන්ත්‍රික සබඳතා යළි ස්ථාපිත කිරීමට මෙම වසර අවසන් වීමට පෙර නව රාජ්‍ය තාන්ත්‍රික මුලපිරීමක් ගත යුතු බවයි.

flores_passage_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo. The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE. Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
question_en: Based on the passage, if the Spanish conquerors had not killed the Taínos between 1492 and 1498, which of the following would most likely have been true?
mc_answer1_en: The Taínos would have continued to inhabit Hispaniola with a significantly larger population.
mc_answer2_en: The population of Taínos would have remained stable throughout the early colonial period.

flores_passage_en: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope. After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll. French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings. Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
question_en: If the 1988 law requiring transparent ballot boxes had not been enacted, which of the following consequences would most likely have occurred based on the passage's description of the voting process?
mc_answer1_en: Candidates would have lost the right to send representatives to witness the voting process.
mc_answer2_en: Officials would have stopped verifying the identity of voters before they cast their ballots.
mc_answer3_en: Volunteers counting the votes would have been unable to sign the voting roll.
mc_answer4_en: Voters would have been unable to verify the integrity of the ballot box contents before voting.
flores_passage: ප්‍රංශයේ, ඡන්දය ප්‍රකාශ කිරීම සම්ප්‍රදායිකව අඩු තාක්ෂණික අත්දැකීමක් වී ඇත: ඡන්දදායකයන් කුටියක් තුළ හුදකලා වී, තමන් කැමති අපේක්ෂකයා සඳහන් කර ඇති පෙර මුද්‍රිත කඩදාසි පත්‍රයක් ලියුම් කවරයක බහාලයි. නිලධාරීන් ඡන්දදායකයාගේ අනන්‍යතාව තහවුරු කළ පසු, ඡන්දදායකයා ලියුම් කවරය ඡන්ද පෙට්ටියට දමා ඡන්ද නාමලේඛනයෙහි අත්සන් තබයි. ප්‍රංශ මැතිවරණ නීතිය මෙම ක්‍රියාපටිපාටි තරමක් දැඩි ලෙස විධිමත් කරයි. 1988 සිට, ඡන්ද විමසීම ආරම්භයේදී කිසිදු ලියුම් කවරයක් නොමැති බවත්, නිසි ලෙස ගණන් ගත් සහ බලයලත් ඡන්දදායකයින්ගේ ලියුම් කවර හැර වෙනත් කිසිදු ලියුම් කවරයක් එකතු නොවන බවත් ඡන්දදායකයින්ට සහ නිරීක්ෂකයින්ට දැකබලා ගත හැකි වන පරිදි ඡන්ද පෙට්ටි විනිවිද පෙනෙන ඒවා විය යුතුය. ක්‍රියාවලියේ සෑම අදියරක්ම නිරීක්ෂණය කිරීම සඳහා නියෝජිතයන් එවීම අපේක්ෂකයින්ට කළ හැකිය. සවස් කාලයේදී, විශේෂිත ක්‍රියාපටිපාටි අනුගමනය කරමින් දැඩි අධීක්ෂණයක් යටතේ ස්වේච්ඡා සේවකයන් විසින් ඡන්ද ගණන් කරනු ලැබේ.
question: විනිවිද පෙනෙන ඡන්ද පෙට්ටි අනිවාර්ය කෙරෙන 1988 නීතිය පනවා නොතිබුණේ නම්, ඡන්ද ක්‍රියාවලිය පිළිබඳ ඡේදයේ විස්තරය මත පදනම්ව පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිවිපාකවලින් වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?
mc_answer1: ඡන්ද ක්‍රියාවලිය නිරීක්ෂණය කිරීම සඳහා නියෝජිතයන් යැවීමේ අයිතිය අපේක්ෂකයින්ට අහිමි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: ඡන්දදායකයින් තම ඡන්දය ප්‍රකාශ කිරීමට පෙර ඔවුන්ගේ අනන්‍යතාව තහවුරු කිරීම නිලධාරීන් විසින් නතර කරනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: ඡන්ද ගණන් කරන ස්වේච්ඡා සේවකයන්ට ඡන්ද නාමලේඛනයට අත්සන් කිරීමට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: ඡන්දය ප්‍රකාශ කිරීමට පෙර ඡන්ද පෙට්ටියේ අන්තර්ගතයේ නිවැරදිභාවය තහවුරු කිරීමට ඡන්දදායකයින්ට නොහැකි වනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: "Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that. Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism. Also blogging ""forces students to become more savvy about the world around them."" The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004). Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day. Appropriate use of blogs ""can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002)."
question_en: According to the passage, if students had not been exposed to blogging, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred?
mc_answer1_en: Students would have defined their positions more clearly through writing.
mc_answer2_en: Students would have developed stronger collaboration skills.
mc_answer3_en: Students would have remained less critical of their own writing.
mc_answer4_en: Students would have become more savvy about the world around them.
flores_passage: බ්ලොග් මඟින් සිසුන්ගේ ලිවීමේ හැකියාව වැඩිදියුණු කිරීමට ද උපකාරී විය හැකිය. සිසුන් බොහෝ විට නොසැලකිලිමත් ව්‍යාකරණ සහ අක්ෂර වින්‍යාසය සහිතව සිය බ්ලොග් අත්දැකීම ආරම්භ කළද, පාඨක පිරිසක් සිටීම සාමාන්‍යයෙන් එය වෙනස් කරයි. බොහෝ විට වඩාත්ම විවේචනාත්මක පාඨකයින් වන්නේ සිසුන්ම බැවින්, බ්ලොග් ලේඛකයා විවේචන මඟහරවා ගැනීම සඳහා සිය ලිවීම වැඩිදියුණු කරගැනීමට උත්සාහ කිරීමට පටන් ගනී. එසේම බ්ලොග්කරණය මඟින් ""සිසුන් තමන් අවට ලෝකය පිළිබඳ වඩාත් දැනුවත් පුද්ගලයන් වීමට බල කරයි."" පාඨකයින්ගේ උනන්දුව පවත්වා ගැනීමේ අවශ්‍යතාව සිසුන් බුද්ධිමත් හා සිත්ගන්නාසුළු වීමට පොළඹවයි (ටෝටෝ, 2004). බ්ලොග්කරණය යනු සහයෝගීතාවය දිරිගන්වන සහ සාම්ප්‍රදායික පාසල් කාලයෙන් ඔබ්බට ඉගෙනීම පුළුල් කිරීමට සිසුන් උනන්දු කරවන මෙවලමකි. බ්ලොග් නිසි ලෙස භාවිත කිරීමෙන් ""සිසුන් වඩාත් විශ්ලේෂණාත්මක සහ විවේචනාත්මක බවට පත්කිරීමට බලගැන්විය හැකිය; අන්තර්ජාල තොරතුරු සඳහා සක්‍රීයව ප්‍රතිචාර දැක්වීම තුළින්, සිසුන්ට අන් අයගේ ලේඛන සන්දර්භය තුළ තම ස්ථාවරය නිර්වචනය කිරීමට මෙන්ම විශේෂිත කරුණු පිළිබඳ තමන්ගේම ආකල්ප පැහැදිලි කිරීමට ද හැකිය (ඔරවෙක්, 2002).
question: ඡේදයට අනුව, සිසුන් බ්ලොග්කරණයට නිරාවරණය නොවූයේ නම්, පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිඵල අතරින් වඩාත්ම සිදුවිය හැක්කේ කුමක්ද?

flores_passage_en: "One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up. Such children are called ""feral"" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment. Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away. Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own. question_en: According to the passage, what would most likely have been different for a feral child who was brought up by wolves, had the child never experienced severe abuse or trauma prior to being abandoned?
mc_answer1_en: The child's behavior would have been less influenced by the wolf's characteristics and more shaped by the abuse.
mc_answer2_en: The child would have rejected the wolf's care and sought human contact immediately upon recovery.
mc_answer3_en: The child would still have exhibited behaviors almost entirely like those of the wolf, as the passage suggests upbringing by animals overrides prior trauma in shaping behavior.
mc_answer4_en: The child would have developed human-like communication skills despite the lack of socialization.

question: ඡේදයට අනුව, අත්හැර දැමීමට පෙර කිසිදා දැඩි අපයෝජනයක් හෝ කම්පනයක් අත්විඳ නොතිබුණේ නම්, වෘකයන් විසින් ඇති දැඩි කරන ලද වනගත දරුවෙකු සම්බන්ධයෙන් බොහෝ දුරට වෙනස් වනු ඇත්තේ කුමක්ද?

mc_answer2: දරුවා වෘකයාගේ රැකවරණය ප්‍රතික්ෂේප කර සුවය ලැබූ වහාම මිනිස් ඇසුර සොයනු ඇත.
mc_answer3: හැසිරීම හැඩගැස්වීමේදී සතුන් විසින් ඇති දැඩි කිරීම පූර්ව කම්පනය ඉක්මවා යන බව ඡේදය අඟවන බැවින්, දරුවා තවමත් බොහෝ දුරට වෘකයාගේ හැසිරීම් වලට සමාන හැසිරීම් ප්‍රදර්ශනය කරනු ඇත.

flores_passage_en: "Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology. Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has ""effects"" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned. For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads. However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership. Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies."
question_en: If the development of technology had not been driven by the logic of scientific laws, according to the passage, which of the following consequences would most likely follow regarding the relationship between technology and society?
mc_answer1_en: Technological development would become entirely dependent on cultural and political influences.
mc_answer2_en: Mass car ownership would not have led to the invention of new healthcare techniques.
mc_answer3_en: The motor car would have necessarily led to the immediate development of a nationwide road network.
mc_answer4_en: Technological determinism would cease to exist as a concept.

question: ඡේදයට අනුව, තාක්ෂණයේ සංවර්ධනය විද්‍යාත්මක නීතිවල තර්කනය මඟින් මෙහෙයවනු නොලැබුවේ නම්, තාක්ෂණය සහ සමාජය අතර සම්බන්ධය සම්බන්ධයෙන් පහත සඳහන් ප්‍රතිවිපාකවලින් වඩාත්ම ඉඩ ඇත්තේ කුමකටද?
mc_answer1: තාක්ෂණික සංවර්ධනය සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම සංස්කෘතික හා දේශපාලනික බලපෑම් මත රඳා පවතිනු ඇත.
mc_answer2: මහා පරිමාණ මෝටර් රථ හිමිකාරිත්වය නව සෞඛ්‍ය ශිල්පක්‍රම සොයා ගැනීමට මඟ පාදන්නේ නැත.
mc_answer3: මෝටර් රථ භාවිතය අනිවාර්යයෙන්ම වහාම රටපුරා මාර්ග ජාලයක් සංවර්ධනය කිරීමට මඟ පාදනු ඇත.
mc_answer4: තාක්ෂණික නිර්ණායකවාදය සංකල්පයක් ලෙස පැවතීම නතර වනු ඇත.
